notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/chirikjianlab__ravens_visual_foresight --backend fake (exit 0, evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 and reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached, no hardware backend exists, and no human review or hardware run is claimed. PyBullet, gym==0.17.3, the upstream assets and the clone were never imported or run: the fake backend is the package's pure-Python analytic model of EnvironmentMCTS, and the upstream simulator is NOT COVERED. The fake models only the demo's default put-block-base-mcts task (3 blocks, 3 target positions), not the other 13 MCTS task classes. Its observation arrays are an 8x8 placeholder colour/depth image per camera rather than the upstream 480x640 RGB-D render (ravens/tasks/cameras.py:26), and its values are test data. Its block poses are sampled uniformly instead of upstream's collision-free get_random_pose, and it ignores pose orientation. It uses Python random.Random while upstream Environment.seed uses numpy RandomState and demos_tvf.py seeds global np.random, so the same seed gives different scenes. The SDK's legacy reset path serves only the first element of the native 6-tuple: base_urdf, base_size, base_id and objs_id are not carried in the reset receipt. cap.world.reset.v1 advertises an options object, but the native reset(self) accepts neither options nor a seed keyword; the bridge's fallback calls env.seed(seed) then reset() and drops options. The action space is Dict(Tuple(Box, Box)) and the SDK's Tuple-in-Dict path publishes structure only, so the pose positions and orientations are not bounded at the envelope; the driver declares no Limit and does not fabricate one, and the fake alone takes the upstream timeout branch for a pose outside the action-space position bounds. That is why G8 warns SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (the suite awards CL2 and every other CL3 test passed); the warning is expected and no limit was invented to clear it. G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 is the family's usual seed warning (the seed is applied at the next reset), and G8.NO_UNIT x3 are the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks and seed twice. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported. The action_space_ref cites ravens/environments/environment.py:89-102 and G4 passed. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. The package-specific cases in test_driver.py cover the native 6-tuple/4-tuple shapes, the served observation, seeded layout repetition, the seed class, the three-block terminal episode, the published fidelity contract and the e-stop latch.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked the pinned Environment/EnvironmentMCTS sources, every Fact/action-space citation, fake semantics, latch and provenance. Added adapter.py and updated driver.py, facts.md and test_driver.py to enforce numeric pose tuple shapes and every sourced position/quaternion bound before dispatch, correct the UR5 reset citation, narrow unsupported Fact clauses and disclose live construction/settling hazards. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the fake gate G1-G9 and package regressions pass without unsigned citation or limit warnings. Strict collection reports only RESULT_DIGEST_STALE because RESULT.json is reserved for the orchestrator. For the human reviewer: Fake-only analytic F0 contract for the default put-block-base-mcts task; no PyBullet, simulator or hardware execution. The adapter preserves the native pose tuple interface and exact base action-space bounds, including y=-0.5..0.5; the task workspace is narrower. Images, layouts, seed trajectories and transitions remain placeholders, and reset drops native bookkeeping fields/options. A live factory would need assets_root, a task, PyBullet/plugin lifecycle handling and bounded settling waits; the model-only latch describes the analytic fake.
